## OP-EC-NEXT: Parallel rank-jump experiments and rank-32 certification

Recorded programme state: **open**. [Canonical scope](../elliptic-curves/README.md).

- **Putting known-record targets into the A1/MW16 parameter experiment** The A1/MW16 experiment samples new parameters directly. Its candidate generator and worker exclude known-record targets, parameters, ranks, points, target j-invariants, and jump labels; record reconstruction remains a separate experiment. Witnesses: [EC-K3-CURVE398-A1-MW16-RECOVERY](../elliptic-curves/notes/ICARM_CURVE398_RANK30_AND_CONSTRUCTION.md) (proved), [EC-K3-CURVE398-TWO-PARENT-COLLISION](../elliptic-curves/notes/ICARM_CURVE398_RANK30_AND_CONSTRUCTION.md) (proved), [EC-K3-ICARM-A1-MW16-ATLAS](../elkies-k3/ICARM_A1_MW16_ATLAS_2026-09-04.md) (proved).

- **Treating R17/MW17 as the unique rank-32 critical path or treating the six norm-twelve atlas misses as exclusions from other K3 fibrations** The complete atlas excludes curves273,302 and398 only from its six classes. Curve398 has a recovered A1/MW16 fibration; its duplicate survivor presentations do not supply two generic structures. Curve302 now has the explicit alternative determinant1092 parent and full saturated generic MW17 basis certified by EC-CURVE302-RECOVERED-MW17-PARENT. Original discoverer provenance remains UNKNOWN. These paths have different generic ranks and demonstrated jumps; no lane is the unique rank32 critical path. Witnesses: [EC-K3-R17-NORM12-RECORD-LINEAGE-ATLAS](../elkies-k3/R17_NORM12_RECORD_LINEAGE_SWEEP_2026-09-04.md) (proved), [EC-K3-R17-NORM12-ICARM-573-REFRESH](../elliptic-curves/notes/ICARM_573_CURVE_REFRESH_OVERVIEW_2026-09-04.md) (proved), [EC-ICARM-CURVE398-RANK30-CONSTRUCTION](../elliptic-curves/notes/ICARM_CURVE398_RANK30_AND_CONSTRUCTION.md) (proved), [EC-K3-CURVE398-A1-MW16-RECOVERY](../elliptic-curves/notes/ICARM_CURVE398_RANK30_AND_CONSTRUCTION.md) (proved), [ECR31](../elliptic-curves/notes/ICARM_CURVE302_RANK31.md) (proved), [EC-ICARM-CURVE302-POINT-CLOUD](../elliptic-curves/notes/ICARM_CURVE302_POINT_CLOUD_RECONSTRUCTION.md) (proved).

- **Treating translated bisection trace shells as new independent rank directions** The exact published-R17 visibility audit shows that the translated shells span only the already-visible one-dimensional direction on the rank-28 control and leave a ten-dimensional target complement. Witnesses: [EC-K3-ELKIES-2026-BISECTION-VISIBILITY-RECORD-CURVES](../elliptic-curves/notes/ELKIES_BISECTION_VISIBILITY_AND_RECORD_CURVES.md) (proved).

The listed proxies and backend timeouts are non-results for that proof gate; they may schedule a finite search but cannot veto it mathematically. Witnesses: [EC-K3-ELKIES-2026-RESIDUAL-SELMER-GATE](../elkies-k3/ELKIES_2026_R17_PAPER_IMPACT_2026-08-27.md) (partial).

Witnesses: [EC-K3-ELKIES-2026-BISECTION-VISIBILITY-RECORD-CURVES](../elliptic-curves/notes/ELKIES_BISECTION_VISIBILITY_AND_RECORD_CURVES.md) (proved).

- **Using finite CRT beam survival as a completeness sieve** Exact four-prime regression shows that branch ordering can change: a width-one beam ends at height 1409 after discarding a branch that completes at height 53. True minimum height is nondecreasing along a fixed branch, but omitted CRT states remain untested. Witnesses: [EC-CRT-BEAM-NONMONOTONE](../elliptic-curves/THEORY.md) (proved).

## OP-K3-DIFFERENT-NS-ARITHMETIC-MW17: Arithmetic-first different-NS MW17 with a certified carrier, or integral V4 rank 20

Recorded programme state: **open**. [Canonical scope](../elkies-k3/DIFFERENT_NS_ARITHMETIC_MW17_FOUNDRY_OBJECTIVE_2026-09-04.md).

- **Using NS0024 or NS0031 as a rational rank-19 marked source over QQ** Independent arithmetic marking obstructions exclude both lattices over QQ even though their geometric and formal corridors remain exact over larger fields or local bases. Witnesses: [EC-K3-NS0024-QQ-MARKING-OBSTRUCTION](../elkies-k3/NS0024_QQ_MARKING_OBSTRUCTION_2026-09-04.md) (proved), [EC-K3-NS0031-QQ-MARKING-OBSTRUCTION](../elkies-k3/NS0031_QQ_MARKING_OBSTRUCTION_2026-09-04.md) (proved).

- **Promoting a modular point, p-adic lift, or formal branch without a rational rank-19 marking** The NS0031 formal branch and physical corridor coexist with a rational marking obstruction, so local or geometric existence does not supply the required arithmetic source. Witnesses: [EC-K3-NS0031-MARKED-FORMAL-BRANCH](../elkies-k3/NS0031_MARKED_FORMAL_BRANCH_2026-09-04.md) (proved), [EC-K3-NS0031-QQ-MARKING-OBSTRUCTION](../elkies-k3/NS0031_QQ_MARKING_OBSTRUCTION_2026-09-04.md) (proved).

- **Using the known determinant-720 rational 3A5 model as the determinant-720 source** Its rational Neron--Severi lattice saturates to determinant 20, and the exact stable curve X_0(60) has no rational noncuspidal point; determinant 720 remains a lattice and corridor control, not an arithmetic source certificate. Witnesses: [EC-K3-GOLAY-DET720-NS-SATURATION](../elkies-k3/GOLAY_OCTAD_LATTICE_DESIGN_2026-09-01.md) (proved), [EC-K3-GOLAY-DET720-QQ-MARKING-OBSTRUCTION](../elkies-k3/GOLAY_DET720_QQ_MARKING_OBSTRUCTION_2026-09-04.md) (proved).

- **Ranking rootless frames or launching equations before the full marked T curve passes** The arithmetic-first planner covers all 827 transcendental rows and deliberately withholds NS, rootless, and equation handoffs until an exact rational non-CM marked point is certified; coarse genus and lattice attractiveness do not supply that marking. Witnesses: [EC-K3-ARITHMETIC-FIRST-MARKED-T-FOUNDRY](../elkies-k3/DIFFERENT_NS_ARITHMETIC_MW17_FOUNDRY_OBJECTIVE_2026-09-04.md) (partial).

- **Promoting a rational point on the determinant-1236 genus-two quotient or one of its rational CM points to a rank-19 marking** The exact period curve is the unresolved degree-two cover X_0^6(103)/<w_618>; quotient points need not lift, and its complete set of ten rational CM points all have geometric Picard rank 20 rather than the requested saturated rank-19 marking. Witnesses: [EC-K3-DET1236-MARKED-SHIMURA-CURVE](../elkies-k3/DET1236_MARKED_SHIMURA_CURVE_2026-09-04.md) (partial), [EC-K3-DET1236-RATIONAL-CM-LOCUS](../elkies-k3/DET1236_MARKED_SHIMURA_CURVE_2026-09-04.md) (proved).

- **Reopening the split determinant-378 X_0(7) row as a rational rank-19 source over QQ** The literal factor-three marking changes the coarse curve to the stable X_0(63) cover, whose rational points are all cusps; no downstream NS or equation gate opens. Witnesses: [EC-K3-DET378-QQ-MARKING-OBSTRUCTION](../elkies-k3/DET378_QQ_MARKING_OBSTRUCTION_2026-09-04.md) (proved).

- **Accepting an unsaturated section subgroup or a supplied target as the different-NS endpoint** Completion requires target-free primitive-nef selection and a saturated seventeen-section Shioda lattice with the new Neron--Severi determinant; the universal compiler and arithmetic reranking preserve those gates. Witnesses: [EC-K3-DIFFERENT-NS-ARITHMETIC-GATE-RERANK](../elkies-k3/DETERMINANT_AWARE_FOUNDRY_RANKING_2026-09-02.md) (partial), [EC-K3-UNIVERSAL-DEGREE2-FIBRATION-COMPILER](../elkies-k3/RANK_MUTATION_AND_LIFT_THEOREMS.md) (proved).

- **Using maximum bridge minimum as a hard candidate sieve** The retrospective fixed-core benchmark already drops one of five rootless classes, and the untouched determinant-78 shell gives the same score to all 277 candidates while direct root classification is faster. It is neither safe nor selective. Witnesses: [EC-K3-INTEGRAL-RANK-TRANSFER-BRIDGE-PREDICTOR-BENCHMARK](../elkies-k3/INTEGRAL_RANK_TRANSFER_GLUE_CALCULUS_2026-09-02.md) (proved), [EC-K3-E6-DET78-PROSPECTIVE-BRIDGE-NEGATIVE](../elkies-k3/INTEGRAL_RANK_TRANSFER_GLUE_CALCULUS_2026-09-02.md) (proved).

- **Treating a common-core root-budget lower bound as an exact rootless-child classifier** The bound is safe only for rejecting declared excessive root budgets and can miss new glue-coset roots; exact theta convolution classifies rootlessness only on the complete fixed-core universes it enumerates. Witnesses: [EC-K3-INTEGRAL-RANK-TRANSFER-BRIDGE-PREDICTOR-BENCHMARK](../elkies-k3/INTEGRAL_RANK_TRANSFER_GLUE_CALCULUS_2026-09-02.md) (proved), [EC-K3-INTEGRAL-RANK-TRANSFER-THETA-CONVOLUTION](../elkies-k3/RANK_MUTATION_AND_LIFT_THEOREMS.md) (proved).

Its rows are not even deduplicated into integral-isometry or J2 classes. Witnesses: [EC-K3-LATTICE-FOUNDRY-PRESCRIBED-ROOT-MW1-CENSUS](../elkies-k3/LATTICE_FOUNDRY_SOURCE_FIRST_OBJECTIVE_2026-09-01.md) (proved).
